verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a docs platform, but nothing in the pack shows the current GitBook product can be self-hosted: the docs describe a hosted SaaS (custom domains, a hosted MCP server, publishing on gitbook.com). Community reports say GitBook moved everything to its SaaS and stopped active development of the old open-source CLI, and the 'mostly open-source' comment refers to that legacy era.
